jobs.title: Product Manager - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.

At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.

The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for. That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.

We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.

This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest - 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time - kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself - Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people - Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness - Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation - Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.

You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening. On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.

Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.

You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.

Team

You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Your top five responsibilities

  1. Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
  2. Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.
  3. Ship AI that holds up in the real world: You'll take AI features from concept to production in a domain where being wrong has consequences. You'll design for human-in-the-loop where the stakes demand it, set the bar for evaluating output quality, and make sure we never ship something that sounds confident and is wrong.
  4. Drive the roadmap and the trade-offs: You'll sequence work into cycles, make the hard prioritisation calls, and communicate them clearly enough that everyone from an engineer to a founder understands why. You'll say no often and well.
  5. Grow yourself and others: We're big on learning and development. You'll raise the product craft around you, give and receive candid feedback, and help build a world-class product function as we scale.

Your Capabilities

You are a product person who is genuinely curious about how things work and impatient about whether they're actually helping anyone. You'd rather find out you were wrong in two weeks than be right in a year. You can hold a strong opinion and change it in front of evidence without ego.

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS products end to end, with a clear track record of driving business outcomes for customers - not just shipping features. You understand enterprise realities: long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement, security, adoption inside organisations that don't change easily.
  • Mastery (AI): Real, hands-on proficiency with AI. You've shipped or seriously prototyped AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs are good and bad at, and you can reason about retrieval and grounding, evaluation, hallucination risk, cost and latency trade-offs, and where a human must stay in the loop. You use AI tools daily in your own work and it shows.
  • Range: You can design for a user in a hi-vis vest with one hand free and poor signal, and for a director who needs to defend a number in a room full of people who'd rather they couldn't. Products that serve both are harder than products that serve either, and you find that interesting rather than annoying.
  • Communication: A clear and compelling communicator. You can make a complex product argument simple, write a crisp strategy document, and hold your own with both a site-based engineer and a senior business leader. You build relationships through a humanistic, empathetic approach, because our customers aren't just users!
  • Leadership: You take ownership. You don't wait for permission, you don't hide behind process, and you're comfortable making a decision with incomplete information and being accountable for it.
  • Impact: You can read between the lines, spot the opportunity nobody asked for, and measure whether it worked. You're rigorous with data but you don't hide behind it.
  • Domain: Ideally some experience in construction, engineering, real estate, or an adjacent complex operational industry (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, field services). What matters most is that you can get deep into a hard, physical, unglamorous domain and love it.

Nice to Have (If you don't have it now you will after joining)

  • Mastery: Experience with mobile-first or field-facing products used in tough physical conditions, and/or with commercial workflows, contracts, change control, claims, cost management, or with products where the output carries legal or contractual weight. If you're not an expert in construction or digital project delivery yet, you will be! We'll give you the tools and knowledge to speak the industry's language.
  • Communication: Experience taking a product to market with sales and marketing, and telling its story publicly, talks, writing, or an extensive network in construction and/or tech.
  • Leadership: Early leadership or people management exposure, experience coaching or mentoring other PMs. We're growing fast, and we want our best product people to step up and take on bigger responsibilities. If you're ambitious, there's a clear path to more.
  • Impact: Experience scaling a product from early traction to a genuine platform, and the scars that come with it. Beyond hitting delivery targets, you'll play a key role in shaping how construction teams adopt technology, and that's a rare thing to be able to say about your work.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on an outcome

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • What do you think you bring to the team?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly.

After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Catalog
jobs.jd_full:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

By catering to both fans and rightsholders, we're powering a new, open entertainment ecosystem where fans have effortless access to experiences, and teams, venues, and shows have seamless access to their audiences. Because everyone should expect more from ticketing.

We are looking for Product Managers with varying levels of experience to join SeatGeek’s R&D team. This role will own SeatGeek's Catalog — the foundational data layer that defines what exists on our platform. Every event a fan can shop, every seat they can buy, every venue map they navigate, and every attribute that makes a ticket more than a dot on a map starts here. Catalog is the ground truth that everything else — shopping, fulfillment, and eventually attending the event — is built on top of.

This is a high-leverage, deeply cross-functional role. When the catalog is accurate, complete, and fresh, fans trust what they see and every downstream experience just works. When it isn't, the cracks show up everywhere. Your mission is to make SeatGeek's understanding of the live event world the most accurate, comprehensive, and richly detailed in the industry — from getting brand-new onsales live the moment they're announced, to modeling complex venues seat-by-seat, to capturing the features and attributes that help fans find exactly the right spot.

SeatGeek is where passionate fans and ambitious builders come together to reshape live entertainment, and if you're excited to build the data foundation that powers it all, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own the vision and strategy for SeatGeek's Catalog and define how we build the most accurate, complete, and fresh representation of the live event world in the industry
  • Raise the bar on catalog coverage and freshness: get new events and onsales live faster, close inventory and matching gaps, and reduce the errors and staleness that erode fan trust and downstream conversion
  • Blend user, data, and domain knowledge to identify where better catalog data can redefine the fan experience (think seat features, views, maps, and enriched event content) and where it unblocks partner and operations workflows
  • Partner closely with operations and marketplace teams to design tooling and processes that let SeatGeek ingest and maintain catalog data at scale
  • Partner with analytics to define the metrics that matter for catalog health — coverage, freshness, accuracy, match rate — and build the dashboards and monitoring to hold the platform accountable to them
  • Advocate for and act as an ambassador to the rest of the company for Catalog, evangelizing work and celebrating wins; collaborate with PMs across the entire shopping funnel and post-purchase experience on dependencies and shared opportunities
  • Stay ahead of where AI, machine learning, and emerging technology can automate ingestion, improve matching, and enrich our representation of the live event experience
  • Provide mentorship to junior product team members and contribute to enhancing our product team culture and best practices

What you have

  • 5+ years of relevant product management experience with a strong track record shipping impactful products at scale, ideally in marketplace, platform, or data-intensive contexts
  • Experience owning foundational data, catalog, or platform products where accuracy, completeness, and freshness are core to the value you deliver — and where downstream teams depend on what you build
  • Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous problem spaces: you can take a messy real-world domain and design systems and processes that make it structured, scalable, and trustworthy
  • A strong fluency with data: you're equally at home defining quality metrics, diving into analytics, and partnering with analysts to get the insights you need to make decisions from evidence rather than assumption
  • Experience partnering with operations teams and designing internal tooling or workflows — you understand that great catalog data is as much about process and people as it is about product
  • Strong customer empathy and a tasteful product eye, even when the "customer" is often an internal operator or a downstream team
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with proficiency in modern prototyping tools like Claude, Figma Make, Loveable, or similar to communicate ideas effectively to cross-functional partners
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams toward ambitious goals with urgency and clarity
  • A demonstrated curiosity in new technologies and how they can solve user problems in new ways
  • Ideally, experience with products that leverage machine learning or AI to automate data ingestion, entity matching, or content enrichment at scale
  • Ideally, experience with marketplace or ticketing products, or other domains where a high-quality catalog or knowledge graph is a core competitive advantage
  • Ability to work East Coast hours (10am-5pm ET) with occasional early starts around 9am ET

Our stack

You absolutely do not need experience with all of these, but we thought you might be curious. Tools can be learned, so we care much more about your general engineering skill than knowledge of a particular language.

  • Languages: Python, Go, C#+.NET Core, Swift, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Client Platforms: iOS, Android, Web (Desktop/Mobile)
  • Technologies: OAuth2.0 & Identity Management, Payment Tokenization
  • Event-driven Technologies: RabbitMQ, Kafka
  • Datastores: Postgres, Redis, Memcache, Elasticsearch
  • Cloud: AWS
  • Version control: Git (Gitlab)

Perks

  • Equity stake
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Student loan matching program
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
  • $500 per year for wellness expenses
  • Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $116,000 - $220,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us!

jobs.title: QNXT Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
We are seeking an QNXT Program Manager to take full accountability for the Claims Workstream within a large-scale QNXT core platform transformation, including migrating from the current IKA platform.

Location: Long Beach, CA (100% Remote)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (PST)

Start Date: 08/10/2026

End Date: 02/10/2027

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of all claims-related implementation activities. You will collaborate closely with product managers and leaders supporting Provider Data, Configuration (provider contracts, benefits, utilization management, business rules), and Capitation to ensure a seamless migration, precise claims adjudication, and operational readiness for go-live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program Leadership & Migration: Accountable for end-to-end implementation and issue resolution for the QNXT Claims workstream, driving the complete migration off the IKA platform.
  • Integrated Planning & Governance: Manage the claims implementation plan across operations, configuration, testing, data conversion, training, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Maintain RAID logs, decision logs, and status reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Workstream Alignment: Coordinate alignment across Claims, Provider Data, Benefits, Utilization Management, and Capitation to ensure accurate future-state claims adjudication, pricing, and payment.
  • Vendor & Consultant Management: Direct day-to-day collaboration with external implementation consultants and software vendors to ensure scope, timelines, deliverables, and architecture decisions stay on track.
  • Testing, Cutover & Stabilization: Lead preparations for system testing, defect triage, mock conversions, go-live cutover, and post-implementation stabilization while validating contingency and readiness plans.
  • Risk & Change Management: Proactively identify execution risks, workflow gaps, and dependency issues to safeguard project timelines, claims accuracy, and stakeholder confidence.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Health Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Experience: Minimum 6 years of related experience within a health plan, managed care, or healthcare organization.
  • Core Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience with QNXT (or a directly comparable core administrative platform) is required.
  • Domain Knowledge: Deep expertise in healthcare payer claims operations and the end-to-end claims lifecycle (adjudication, pricing, payment, and provider/benefit configuration interactions).
  • Transformation Leadership: Proven experience leading large, cross-functional system implementations or platform migrations involving data conversion, system testing, defect triage, mock conversions, cutover planning, and go-live stabilization.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Visio, Access, and SQL.
  • Work Schedule: Ability to work standard PST business hours (Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (MBA, MPH, MHA, or MS in Information Systems).
  • Direct experience leading IKA-to-QNXT platform migrations.
  • Experience driving AI-driven operational improvements within healthcare claims environments.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Ability to take end-to-end ownership of a high-stakes, enterprise claims implementation with minimal supervision.
  • Strong consensus-building and coaching skills to align senior leadership, technical teams, consultants, and vendors around common priorities.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous transformation environments.
  • Sharp analytical, risk-management, and decision-making skills to resolve blockers before they impact critical path timelines.
  • Exceptional executive-level communication and change-leadership abilities.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead - India
jobs.jd_full:
About the Team

The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence across India. Reporting to the General Manager, India, this leader will work hand in hand with the GM to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.

This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.

This role is based in Bangalore, India and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and implement the India operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.

  • Drive execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.

  • Partner with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.

  • Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.

  • Build and optimize scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.

  • Identify operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support market entry strategies and operational readiness for India

  • Enable strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.

  • Help build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.

  • Collaborate closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.

  • Ensure seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.

  • Act as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across India.

  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing regional operations team.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

  • Develop leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.

  • Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.

  • Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within India.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.

  • Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager - Bay Area Based
jobs.jd_full:
At Side, we believe everyone should own their path.

Side partners with top-producing real estate professionals to help them own and operate their own boutique real estate companies, without the legal, regulatory, or operational complexity of running a traditional brokerage. As a pioneer in the Brokerage-as-a-Service model, Side provides a proprietary platform that increases efficiency, strengthens client relationships, and enables entrepreneurs to focus on what they do best — selling real estate and growing their businesses.

Headquartered in San Francisco and backed by more than $300 million from top-tier venture capital firms, Side is recognized as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in real estate. At Side, you’ll work alongside experienced industry leaders and world-class engineers to help shape the future of real estate and empower exceptional professionals to thrive as business owners.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Product team at Side drives product vision, strategic planning, and the design, rollout, and measurement of new products and features. The team is responsible for delivering products that delight customers and impact the business, and for measuring that impact against well-defined success outcomes. We build products iteratively based on data-directed insights and user feedback, and generate insightful hypotheses about our users and their needs. We regularly collaborate with internal partners and are in a unique position of easy access to users for real time feedback due to our close partnerships with our customers & their teams. We believe that collaboration, teamwork, and communication are critical to the product development process. We strive to communicate clearly, manage expectations proactively, and exercise full transparency with our partners and teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate Product Manager who is new or early in the Product Management career path, you will be learning and applying core Product skills.  Your focus will be on execution with the UX and Engineering members on your team, under the guidance and coaching of senior Product team members, and working on defined problems and features in our Transaction & Compliance Management product.  You will clearly define product work, participate in planning, test and validate completed work, and participate in release planning and communication.  In partnership with adjacent teams on the platform, you will leverage both product iteration and 10x innovation to provide industry-leading automation, efficiency, and ease-of-use.   You will deeply understand the customer, begin to leverage data to validate solution impact, and play a key role in driving predictable, measurable success for our customers and for Side.

This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco headquarters. To foster collaboration and maintain our fast-paced culture, we require 2 days per week in the office.

What you’ll be doing

  • In partnership with your UX and Engineering Lead counterparts, and with guidance from senior Product team members, driving the work of the Agile team to produce high-quality, reliable, and high-impact product iterations and releases
  • Clearly defining product features, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria to empower efficient and high-quality product work, leveraging AI tools to amplify your work and impact
  • Coding with AI to produce prototypes, examples, and other artifacts for clearly articulating features and requirements
  • Leveraging data analytics and qualitative understanding to validate feature adoption and impact
  • Collaborating with senior Product team members to prioritize the backlog of work to deliver the most impactful and strategically sequenced releases and improvements
  • Participating in team Agile ceremonies to groom, plan, execute, and improve
  • Working with the Go-to-Market team to document product releases for internal and external stakeholders, and providing team updates/training for major releases
  • Releasing as needed to alpha/beta groups for refinement, feedback, and hardening
  • Contributing skills, artifacts, and best practices for AI use in the team

What will make you a strong fit for the role

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Comfort with distilling ambiguity into an actionable path to execute and learn
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to tailor communication style, format, and depth based on your audience
  • Aptitude working with technology and collaborating with others who have varying degrees of technical skills
  • Extreme comfort using AI tools and skills to accelerate your work and expand the breadth of your impact
  • Ability to organize and leverage data for evaluation and decision making
  • Growth Mindset: embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, focus on fearless learning, thrive on effort
  • Experience working directly with customers and with interdisciplinary cross-functional teams
  • Ownership mentality with strong execution capability and a track record of achieving measurable results
  • High empathy, curiosity, self-awareness, and transparency in both wins and misses
  • Strong work ethic with a willingness to dive deep into the details
  • Bonus: experience with data analytics - SQL, advanced spreadsheet functions, business analytics tools
  • B.A., B.S. or equivalent

$115,000 - $140,000 a year

Competitive salary

Stock options

Best-in-class benefits, including 100% healthcare coverage (medical, vision and dental)

Learning & Development credit

Pet friendly environment
